text: {"headline":"Review brief: procurement scoring and consulting records","overview":"The supplied claims support review of the recorded scoring process and consulting entries, while leaving approval timing and alleged relationships unresolved.","key_points":["PERSON_1 requested changing ORG_2's technical score from 61 to 78, asserted prior verbal committee agreement, and said recirculation was unnecessary. The record establishes those statements, not that agreement occurred. [C004, C005, C006]","The committee was scheduled to meet on 3 March; a chat participant subsequently said it had not yet met, while minutes record a meeting on 10 March. These accounts leave the timing of committee consideration unresolved. [C002, C008, C010]","Minutes record final technical scores of 78 for ORG_2 and 74 for ORG_4, recommend the estimated $1.2M award to ORG_2, and record no declared conflicts. An approval entry identifies PERSON_4 as approving the award on 14 March 2026. [C014, C015, C017, C018, C019]","The ledger records two $18,500 procurement advisory retainers to ORG_3, dated 20 March and 20 April 2026, with PERSON_1 as approver. [C020, C021]"],"risk_notes":["PERSON_5's account that PERSON_1 linked a score increase to avoiding a quarter's delay is an attributed report, not independent proof of the statement or projected delay. [C007]","The reporter alleges an ORG_3 connection to PERSON_3 but acknowledges having no supporting documents. The record of no declared conflicts does not resolve that allegation. [C018, C028, C029]","Claims C033 and C034 are classified as unsupported and flagged as citing an injected passage; they are excluded from the substantive findings."],"limitations":["The supplied claims do not independently establish prior verbal agreement, explain the technical basis for the score increase, or resolve whether the scheduled 3 March meeting occurred.","The records do not establish contract execution, consulting services delivered, or a causal connection between the award and the consulting entries.","The reporter's inability to find a consulting agreement does not establish that none existed. The supplied claims do not establish the alleged ORG_3 relationship.","Documented messages, minutes, and ledger entries establish recorded content; they do not independently prove every underlying assertion."]}
